platform.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

training.summary: One adapter, trained once in phase T and frozen. Rank-r low-rank updates (y = W x + scale (alpha / r) B A x) on the chosen module family in decoder layers 2 to 5; A drawn from randn / sqrt(fan_in), B zero, both float32, the branch run in bfloat16. At scale 0 the branch is skipped, so the model is Glimmer bit for bit (checked).
training.family_rule: compare_pilots.choose_family over results/pilots/c5-{all,qk,gate,v,o,mlp}.json (eligibility and ranking written 2026-10-28 before the family runs; choose_family written the same day while they ran, before any family result was seen): the winner if it is a single family; if the winner is "all", the single family among its 2-point ties with the largest scale-1 flattening; otherwise "all"; "all" if none is eligible. Result at sealing (results/pilots/compare.txt, commit d0438b7): all six families eligible; scale-1 changes all -20.1, mlp -14.2, v -12.2, gate -9.7, qk -9.0, o -8.2 percent; winner all; no single family within 2 points of it (closest mlp, 5.9 points); family = all, so the pilot run 3 numbers in the header describe the sealed recipe's family.
training.window: tokens 2,048 to 6,143 (W = 4,096); one tone per period, amplitude 0.1 x the region's median residual norm
training.tilt0_note: The pilot normalized by the mean held-out tilt at 8,192 tokens; C5 uses the mean base tilt of its training regions at 6,144 tokens over the training periods. Both are expected near 0.13 on this model (pilot start tilt 0.1316 at 8,192), so the weight of the tilt loss against KL should be comparable; the value used is recorded in training.json as tilt0. At sealing: the pilot's training-text tilt at 6,144 tokens was 0.1215 (results/pilots/c5-all.json base_gain_6144) against its normalizer 0.1316, a ratio of 0.92; the C5 smoke run's regional base tilts were 0.1534, 0.1580, 0.1537 and 0.1419 (mean 0.1518, which is C5's normalizer), a ratio near 1.0. For the same relative miss, C5's tilt term therefore weighs about (1 / 0.92)^2 = 1.17 times the pilot's against KL; the KL budget, excess penalty and rollback are unchanged.
training.loss: ((tilt - target) / tilt0)^2 + beta x KL + beta_excess x max(0, KL - kl_budget), where tilt is the slope of ln(mean head gain) on ln(N) over the step's periods from an undriven and a driven pass at the step's scale (lock-in projections at every measured head; src/dialedin/pilot_c5.py), target uses the base tilt of the same region and periods from the base-gain cache (mean over base_seeds), and tilt0 is the mean base tilt over the regions over all training periods.
training.checkpointing: every decoder layer's forward is checkpointed (non-reentrant); the drive is added outside it
training.determinism: training runs with torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(False), since some backward kernels have no deterministic version (training.json records training_deterministic false); measurement phases are deterministic as in C1 to C4
training.output: results/raw/<run_id>/adapter.pt and training.json with the adapter's sha256; phases A, B and R refuse an adapter whose sha256 differs
training.no_retraining: One training per seal. Once any run under the seal has a training.json, no new phase T is admitted, whatever the reason; that run must be continued. A training that crashes before writing training.json may be restarted only with a written infrastructure reason. An unstable training is reported as is.
